verdict.rationale: Fenwick documents a secure, client-facing 'custom trademark extranet' with immediate access to documents, docket status, and synchronized reporting, plus real-time budget/status dashboards for matters — directly matching the client portal concept. However, the documented extranet is scoped specifically to trademark portfolios rather than a firm-wide matter/document portal, and no security architecture (encryption, auth, access controls) is detailed. Missing for 10: evidence of a general cross-practice matter/document portal, and documented security/authentication mechanisms for the extranet.
